ns0:svg.data-production-method: Native outlined type, frame contours, icons, counters and rarity stars; retained artwork, brush materials and logo masks.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Black Gambit

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
When entering Combat, reveal your hand. With
at least 3 Black Style cards, attach this to your
MP. While attached, you may discard a hand card
during your Attacker Attacks phase to discard an
opposing Setup, Drill, Ally or Battleground in play.
